Utility functions for ML

```{r, eval=FALSE}

# Utility functions
#' Function to collect metadata and abundances from ps object
prep_ml_input <- function(ps, metadata_list) {
    # collect metdata
    metadata_df <- microbiome::meta(ps) %>%
        dplyr::select(all_of(metadata_list))
    ml_input <- microbiome::abundances(ps) %>%
        t() %>%
        as.data.frame() %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "participant_id") %>%
        dplyr::left_join(metadata_df)
    return(ml_input)
}


lasso_model <- function(train, test) {
    doParallel::registerDoParallel()

    ind <- list(
        analysis = seq(nrow(train)),
        assessment = nrow(train) + seq(nrow(test))
    )
    splits <- rsample::make_splits(ind, dplyr::bind_rows(train, test))
    ml_train <- rsample::training(splits)
    ml_test <- rsample::testing(splits)

    # # Generate 10-fold CV model with 5 repetitions, stratified by PD status
    set.seed(42)
    train_folds <- vfold_cv(ml_train,
        v = 10,
        strata = case_control_other_latest
    )

    # Define tunable Lasso model
    tune_spec <- logistic_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>%
        set_engine("glmnet")

    ml_recipe <- recipes::recipe(
        case_control_other_latest ~ .,
        data = ml_train
    ) %>%
        recipes::update_role(participant_id, new_role = "participant_id") %>%
        recipes::update_role(sex, new_role = "sex") %>%
        recipes::update_role(study, new_role = "study") %>%
        recipes::step_nzv(all_predictors()) %>%
        recipes::step_normalize(all_predictors())

    wf <- workflow() %>%
        add_recipe(ml_recipe) %>%
        add_model(tune_spec)

    # TUNE MODEL ---
    lambda_grid <- dials::grid_regular(penalty(), levels = 10)
    lasso_grid <- tune::tune_grid(wf,
        resamples = train_folds,
        grid = lambda_grid
    )

    # select optimal penalty by filtering largest rocauc
    best_aucroc <- tune::select_best(lasso_grid, "roc_auc")

    # Extract metrics from optimal models (average of N bootstraps)
    train_metrics <- tune::collect_metrics(lasso_grid) %>%
        dplyr::filter(penalty == best_aucroc$penalty)

    # Finalize and fit workflow with tuned parameters
    train_lasso <- finalize_workflow(wf, best_aucroc) %>%
        fit(ml_train)

    # Predictions on test data
    test_lasso <- tune::last_fit(train_lasso, split = splits)
    test_metrics <- tune::collect_metrics(test_lasso)

    conf_matrix <- tune::collect_predictions(test_lasso) %>%
        conf_mat(case_control_other_latest, .pred_class) %>%
        autoplot()
    print(conf_matrix)

    output <- list(
        "bootstrap_tune_model" = lasso_grid,
        "train_lasso" = train_lasso,
        "test_lasso" = test_lasso,
        "train_metrics" = train_metrics,
        "test_metrics" = test_metrics
    )
    return(output)
}

#' Function to summarize model performance between two phyloseq objects
ml_summary <- function(obj_A, obj_B, label_A, label_B, metadata_of_interest) {
    ml_input_A <- prep_ml_input(obj_A, metadata_of_interest)
    ml_input_B <- prep_ml_input(obj_B, metadata_of_interest)

    A_vs_B <- lasso_model(train = ml_input_A, test = ml_input_B)
    summary_A <-
        bind_rows(
            A_vs_B$train_metrics %>%
                mutate(train = label_A, test = label_A, model = "10-fold CV"),
            A_vs_B$test_metrics %>%
                mutate(train = label_A, test = label_B, model = "Prediction")
        ) %>%
        mutate(analysis = "Study-to-Study Transfer")
    return(summary_A)
}

```

Study to study transfer


```{r, eval=FALSE}

metadata_of_interest <-
    c("participant_id", "case_control_other_latest", "sex", "study")
ml_cohorts <- c("BioFIND", "HBS", "PDBP", "PPMI",)
test_pairs <- expand.grid(ml_cohorts, ml_cohorts)


# Iterating through pairs of phyloseq objects
s2s_data <- purrr::map2(
    test_pairs$Var1, test_pairs$Var2,
    ~ ml_summary(
        obj_A = ps_list[[.x]],
        obj_B = ps_list[[.y]],
        label_A = .x,
        label_B = .y,
        metadata_of_interest
    )) %>%
    bind_rows()


saveRDS(
    s2s_data,
    glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/ml/s2s_transfer_LASSO_{Sys.Date()}.rds")
)


```

Leave-one-cohort-out cross-validation


```{r, eval=FALSE}

ps_model_loo <- ml_cohorts %>%
    purrr::set_names(glue("LOO_{.}")) %>%
    purrr::map(function(x) {
        filtered_sample_data <- subset(sample_data(ps_model), study != x)
        prune_samples(sample_names(filtered_sample_data), ps_model)
    })

# Double checking LOO list
ps_model_loo %>%
    purrr::map(
        ~ meta(.) %>% pull(study) %>% table
    )

loo_test_pairs <- data.frame(
    Var1 = names(ps_model_loo),
    Var2 = gsub("LOO_", "", names(ps_model_loo))
    )

loo_data <- purrr::map2(
    loo_test_pairs$Var1, loo_test_pairs$Var2,
    ~ ml_summary(
        obj_A = ps_model_loo[[.x]],
        obj_B = ps_list[[.y]],
        label_A = .x,
        label_B = .y,
        metadata_of_interest
    )) %>%
    bind_rows()

saveRDS(
    ps_model_loo,
    glue("{wkdir}/data/interim/ml/s2s_transfer_LOO_{Sys.Date()}.rds")
)

```

Visualizing results

```{r, eval=FALSE}

ml_heatmap_summary <- function(ml_summary) {
  ml_summary %>%
      mutate(model_perf = coalesce(mean, .estimate)) %>%
      filter(.metric == "roc_auc") %>%
      distinct() %>%
      filter(!(train == test & model == "Prediction")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = .metric, values_from = "model_perf") %>% View
    ggplot(aes(x = train, y = test, fill = roc_auc)) +
    theme_bw() +
    geom_tile() +
    labs(x = "Training set", y = "Test set", fill = "AUROC") +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(roc_auc, digits = 2)),
      size = 3,
      vjust = 0.77, color = "white"
    ) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
        option = "magma", limits = c(0.5, 1), direction = 1,
        begin = 0, end = 1,
        oob = scales::squish
    ) +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = 1, barheight = 7)) +
    theme(
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    )
}


p_s2s_heatmap <- ml_heatmap_summary(s2s_data)
ggsave(
    glue("{wkdir}/figures/ml/s2s_transfer_heatmap_{Sys.Date()}.png"),
    p_s2s_heatmap,
    width = 6, height = 5
)

```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
    y = "AUROC", fill = "Test set") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#525152", "white")) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(
    glue("{wkdir}/figures/ml/LOO_barchart_{Sys.Date()}.png"),
    p_loo,
    width = 4, height = 4
)


```


![Study to Study Transfer Heatmap](../figures/ml/s2s_transfer_heatmap_2024-02-27.png){#fig1}

In the S2S strategy, a lasso regression model is trained on one study and tested on another. The heatmap above shows the AUROC of the model when trained on one study and tested on another. The diagonal represents the performance of the model during a 10 fold cross-validation search for optimal hyperparameters. The model performs best when trained and tested on the same study, and performs very poorly when trained on one study and tested on another.


![Leave one out Barchart](../figures/ml/LOO_barchart_2024-02-27.png){#fig2}

In the LOO strategy, a lasso regression model is trained on all studies except one and tested on the left out study. The barchart above shows the AUROC of the model when trained on all studies except one (average 10f fold CV value during hyperparameter search) and tested on the left out study. The model performs fairly poorly in nearly every case.
